decisions.reason: As a prominently presented 2018 launch that is close to the firm's traditional handcrafted seasonal décor, it is likely to be retained because the public commitment is visible and any early uncertainty can still be seen as temporary.

This product closely fits the firm's established Christmas pyramid range and was featured on the home page, so management would be inclined to continue it rather than reverse a visible recent commitment.

Although more distant from the traditional offer, the electronic music box was prominently launched and likely required notable development effort, which under escalation of commitment favors giving it more time instead of withdrawing quickly.
As a complementary platform for the new electronic music box line, it would likely be kept to support the firm's prior investment in that system and avoid signaling retreat after the launch.

This Christmas-themed platform extends the same new music-box concept, and management would likely continue it because the sunk effort in the broader line and the possibility of seasonal uptake encourage persistence.
Because it builds directly on the firm's core pyramid tradition while adding a distinctive Dresden theme and was highlighted on the home page, it would very likely be maintained.
